Economics BSc at University of Bath

What University of Bath asks of applicants to Economics BSc for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

UK · All University of Bath courses · Economics & Finance field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 7 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • For applicants with a US high-school diploma: SAT/ACT is not part of the published requirement, which is set in AP tests (5, 5, 5 in three AP tests including Calculus AB or BC)
  • Bath also looks for evidence of a high academic standard across a breadth of study — including SAT or ACT scores if you have taken them
Verified19 Oct 2026Bath: BSc Economics (2027 entry)
English language
  • Bath English language Category B
  • IELTS 7.0 overall with no less than 6.5 in all components
  • TOEFL iBT:
    • 100 overall with a minimum 24 in all components (taken up to 21 Jan 2026)
    • 5 overall with a minimum 4.5 in all components (taken after 21 Jan 2026)
  • PTE Academic 69 with no less than 62 in any element
  • Needed if you do not meet Bath’s GCSE English requirement
Verified19 Oct 2026Bath: BSc Economics (2027 entry)

None listed on the official source

Other qualifications
  • For applicants with a US high-school diploma: Advanced Placement 5, 5, 5 in three AP tests including Calculus AB or Calculus BC
  • No more than one Calculus AP counts; AP Seminar and AP Research are not accepted
  • Without APs: honours, dual-enrolment or equivalent advanced classes may be considered case by case — typically one such class in place of each AP test
Verified19 Oct 2026Bath: BSc Economics (2027 entry)
Other requirements
  • Whole-application selection: previous academic achievements (such as GCSEs), predicted or achieved grades, A-level (or equivalent) subjects, and the personal statement
  • Only the UCAS personal statement is assessed — alternative or supplementary statements are not usually considered
  • Interview: only for Access to HE applicants, or very exceptionally where circumstances cannot be assessed from the application
Verified19 Oct 2026Bath: BSc Economics (2027 entry)
